messages.content:
Pretty bloody quick — usually I can spit out a reply in under a second or two. If I’m fetching stuff from the web (opening pages, searching, loading videos) that adds network time — typically 0.5–5s per action depending on the site and your connection. Big jobs (long docs, heavy scraping, or complex analysis) can take a bit longer — seconds to a minute.

Want me to do a live speed test — open a page and time how long it takes?
